title: Surface CI persist outcome + test CI restore path
goal: Make the ADR-050 state-branch snapshot outcome visible in CI job logs, delete stale test-residue origin branch, and add tests for the CI restore path and persist-result.json snapshot field.

steps.description: Add an always-run 'Surface persist result' CI step after 'Push work branch' that uses find to locate persist-result.json under $ZBUILD_STATE_DIR, reads it with jq, and emits ::notice:: annotations for verdict/snapshot/pushed/reason fields. This closes acceptance criterion 1: the snapshot outcome (saved/empty/unchanged/failed + reason) is visible in every CI job log.

Add an always-run 'Delete stale test-residue state branch' CI step that runs git push --delete origin zbuild/state/issue-4244 when that ref exists on origin. This is a one-time cleanup of the branch pushed by a pre-secret-gate version of persist-stage-test.sh.

Add a T-CI-restore test to artifact-persist-test.sh: create a bare remote, commit a state tree to it, fetch the state branch into refs/remotes/origin/zbuild/state/issue-N on the local fixture repo, call _artifact_persist_restore, and assert it extracts the files correctly. This covers the CI cold-start restore path (line 365-366 of artifact-persist.sh) which has no test today.

Add assertions to persist-stage-test.sh on the data.snapshot field in persist-result.json: (a) for the no-issue guard case assert data.snapshot == 'skipped'; (b) for the credential-refused case assert data.snapshot is non-null (snapshot ran before the gate). These two cases prove the snapshot field flows through _persist_write_result correctly.

notes: Acceptance criterion 2 ('cause stated before implementation') is already satisfied in the issue body: the original defect (no git push existed at all) is fixed by ADR-059 Phase 2; the remaining gap is diagnostic visibility, not a new code path. Acceptance criterion 3 ('second CI run restores artifacts') requires a live dogfood run and cannot be proven by unit tests alone — the PR description must include the dogfood run log. The 'Push work branch' step at lines 235-243 already emits ::notice::no state branch when nothing was snapshotted; step-1 adds the richer persist-result.json fields so the reason for the missing snapshot is also visible. The step-2 deletion is idempotent: if origin/zbuild/state/issue-4244 is already gone the git push --delete exits 0 silently via || true.
